fields.summary: Except as provided in paragraph (b) of 49 CFR 392.10, the driver of a commercial motor vehicle specified in paragraphs (a)(1) through (6) of 49 CFR 392.10 must not cross a railroad track or tracks at grade unless he or she first stops the commercial motor vehicle within 50 feet of, and not closer than 15 feet to, the tracks, thereafter listens and looks in each direction along the tracks for an approaching train, and ascertains that no train is approaching.
fields.actor: the driver of a commercial motor vehicle specified in paragraphs (a) (1) through (6) of this section
fields.quote: (a) Except as provided in paragraph (b) of this section, the driver of a commercial motor vehicle specified in paragraphs (a) (1) through (6) of this section shall not cross a railroad track or tracks at grade unless he/she first: Stops the commercial motor vehicle within 50 feet of, and not closer than 15 feet to, the tracks; thereafter listens and looks in each direction along the tracks for an approaching train; and ascertains that no train is approaching. When it is safe to do so, the driver may drive the commercial motor vehicle across the tracks in a gear that permits the commercial motor vehicle to complete the crossing without a change of gears. The driver must not shift gears while crossing the tracks.
